verses.text: Israel was like a healthy vine that produced plenty of fruit. The more fruit it produced, the more altars it built. The richer the land became, the more beautiful they made their sacred stones.
Their hearts are false, and now they must pay for their guilt. The LORD will tear down their altars and destroy their sacred stones.
Soon they will say, "We have no king because we did not fear the LORD. But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?"
They make many promises, swear false oaths, and make agreements. So lawsuits spring up like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

The people who live in Samaria will be afraid for the calf idol of Beth Aven. Its people will mourn over it, and so will its priests, who used to celebrate its glory, because its glory will be taken away from it.
It will be carried off to Assyria as a gift for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced, and Israel will be ashamed of its idols.
Samaria and its king will float away like a twig on the surface of the water.

The high places of wickedness, where Israel sinned, will be destroyed. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" and to the hills, "Fall on us!"
"Israel, you have sinned ever since the days of Gibeah, and you have kept on sinning there. Did not war overtake the wicked people at Gibeah?
When I choose, I will punish them. Nations will gather against them to put them in chains for their double sin.
Ephraim is like a trained young cow that loves to thresh grain. So I will put a yoke on her fine neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.
Plant goodness for yourselves, and harvest the fruit of faithful love. Break up your unplowed ground, because it is time to look for the LORD, until he comes and showers goodness on you.
But you have planted wickedness and harvested evil. You have eaten the fruit of lies. You trusted in your own strength and in your many soldiers.

So the roar of battle will rise against your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed. It will be like the day Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in battle, when mothers and their children were dashed to pieces.
That is what will happen to you, Bethel, because your wickedness is so great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.
